mapper.sql: te.id, te.user_id, te.process_instance_id, te.training_theme, te.training_time, te.training_location, te.training_duration, te.achieve_results, te.training_teachers, te.remark,
fu.id as file_id, fu.biz_id as file_biz_id, fu.file_name, fu.file_size, fu.file_url, fu.file_absolute_url, fu.remark as file_remark
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, f.file_name as name, f.file_url as fileUrl,f.id as fileId,f.file_size as size FROM efvs_training_experience t LEFT JOIN efvs_file_upload f ON t.id = f.biz_id WHERE t.id = #{param1} and t.deleted = 0 and t.tenant_id = #{param2}

select te.id, te.user_id, te.process_instance_id, te.training_theme, te.training_time, te.training_location, te.training_duration, te.achieve_results, te.training_teachers, te.remark from efvs_training_experience te where te.id = #{param1}
